text.description: a yes/no question about today's package, at most 200 characters, ending with ?

metric.description: the series that settles it, with its source; empty for event and judgment

threshold.description: the level as written, e.g. 86.61B; empty when not a threshold

baseline_quote.description: the package line giving today's value, copied verbatim; empty for judgment

settled_quote.description: a package line that already reports what settles_with names (the event happened, the level was crossed), copied verbatim; empty when nothing in the package settles it

settles_with.description: the observable or event and where it is published

carried_from.description: ledger id such as 2026-09-11-q2 if this re-asks an open question, else empty
